parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;

const message = [
  ' PULSECHAIN — TIER 1 EMERGENCY',
  '================================',
  'Region:       ' + d.region_name,
  'Risk Score:   ' + (d.posterior_probability * 100).toFixed(1) + '%',
  'Confidence:   ' + (d.confidence * 100).toFixed(0) + '%',
  'Dominant:     ' + d.dominant_signal,
  '',
  'Summary: ' + d.explanation_summary,
  '',
  'Signal Drivers:',
  ...(d.drivers || []).map(dr =>
    '  • ' + (dr.label || dr.source || dr) + ': ' + (dr.display || dr.value || '')
  ),
  '',
  'Recommended Actions:',
  ...(d.recommended_actions || []).map(a => '  • ' + a),
  '',
  'Spread Risks:',
  ...(d.spread_forecast?.spread_risks || []).slice(0, 3).map(
    r => '  → ' + r.target + ': P=' + (r.spread_probability * 100).toFixed(0) + '% ETA=' + r.eta_days + 'd'
  ),
  '',
  'Lead Time Estimate: ' + (d.lead_time_estimate || '3-7 days'),
  'Assessment ID: ' + d.event_id,
  'Timestamp: ' + d.assessed_at
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    to: "your-email@example.com",
    subject: " PULSECHAIN — TIER 1 EMERGENCY",
    region:d.region_name,
    text: message,
    event_id: d.event_id,
    recommended_actions: d.recommended_actions,
    notification_channel: "tier1_emergency",
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }
}];
